lessons_used: Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, sequence reordering, interactive wait flows and tips, and interactive desktop hotkey setup were helpful.
Hints outside sign-in, copy updates, sign-in step reordering, and layout changes showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens hurt performance or showed no clear effect, with the exception of interactive desktop hotkey setup.
Predictions were too high for failed, harmful, or no-effect changes, overestimating gains.
Predictions were too low for winning sequence reorderings, interactive waiting flows, and setup screens expected to perform poorly.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Customization Playroom Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive trait preview flow to friend selection where users can play test companion behaviors before confirming adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (37.3% drop) and long decision times (median 89s / mean 1017s); interactive previews increase engagement.

pick_friend.headline: Test Companion Personality Traits
pick_friend.body: Interact with companion personalities to see how your desktop pet will behave.

guard.reason: Valid interactive trait preview added to friend selection screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off, but new flows historically fail to improve conversion.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Activity Stage Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated interactive pet activity stage screen while background desktop rendering completes.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s. Interactive wait flows have previously proven highly effective.

new_desktop_stage.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready!
new_desktop_stage.body: Play with your pet's starter toys while we configure desktop permissions.

guard.reason: Valid new onboarding screen added prior to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Interactive wait flows work well, though introducing new screens carries extra cost and risk.

candidates.title: Interactive Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into an interactive celebration stage with animated mascot signatures.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low completion (62.7%). Redesigning certificate signing into a rewarding interactive stage drives completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Finalize Your Pet's Official Adoption

candidates.title: Sign-In Post-Adoption Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders the onboarding journey so account sign-in happens after picking and naming the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Moving account creation after pet customization builds attachment first and reduces initial sign-in friction.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your custom companion synced across all your devices.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in screen to occur after adoption certificate.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step reordering has consistently hurt performance in past tests.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit sync reassurance hint on the sign-in screen confirming existing pets will be automatically restored.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing back in.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to sign-in screen regarding account restoration.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints are strongly supported by support emails and past test results.

candidates.change: Displays breakdown progress stages and estimated completion time during desktop engine loading.

waiting.hint: Configuring desktop overlay engine and companion animations...

guard.reason: Valid engine loading progress information added to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Progress feedback during wait steps has reliably improved retention.

candidates.title: Path Story Companion Behavior Callout Hint

choose_path.hint: Your chosen story path influences your companion's daily desktop interactions and habits.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to choose path screen explaining personality impacts.

candidates.score_note: Hints outside sign-in have shown no meaningful effect in historical data.

candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive tutorial screen demonstrating how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on the desktop.

lessons_next: Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, sequence reordering, interactive waiting flows/tips, interactive hotkey setup screen, and desktop welcome quick-action redesign were helpful.
Hints outside of sign-in, copy updates, layout changes, and sign-in reordering showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens hurt performance or showed no clear effect, except for the interactive desktop hotkey setup screen.
Predictions overestimated gains for failed, harmful, or no-effect changes.
Predictions were too low for unexpected winning changes such as sequence reordering, interactive waiting flows, hotkey setup screen, and desktop quick-action redesign.
